# .1 Chartered Factory Annual Dividend (1480+ quarterly dispatch)
oe_col3.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v122_chartered_company.dds"
	title = oe_col3.1.t
	desc = oe_col3.1.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.1.a
		add_gold = 120
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col3_company_dividend_boom_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.1.b
		add_gold = 45
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:burghers_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col3_supply_convoy_mod
			years = 3
			mode = replace
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}
}

# .5 Overseas Tariffs & Representation (1700+ opening clash, Stage 0 -> 1)
oe_col3.5 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v122_tea_boycott.dds"
	title = oe_col3.5.t
	desc = oe_col3.5.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = { oe_col3_ensure_init = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.5.a
		add_gold = 180
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		oe_col3_inc_crackdown_heat = yes
		every_subject = {
			limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = 10
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.5.b
		add_stability = 5
		every_subject = {
			limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = -10
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 55 }
	}
}

# .8 Charter of the Imperial Federation (triggered by oe_col3_dec_imperial_federation_seat;
#    soft-links v11.0 Endgame War & v12.0 Eurasian Concert!)
oe_col3.8 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v122_imperial_federation.dds"
	title = oe_col3.8.t
	desc = oe_col3.8.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.8.a
		add_stability = 8
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
					has_country_modifier = oe_end_hegemon_aligned_mod
				}
			}
			add_gold = 200
			add_stability = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_con_concert_sovereignty_mod
					AND = {
						exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					}
				}
			}
			add_stability = 5
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}

# .11 Declaration of Overseas Independence (1765+ with crackdown_heat >= 3, no Imperial Federation)
oe_col3.11 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v122_independence_wave.dds"
	title = oe_col3.11.t
	desc = oe_col3.11.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = { oe_col3_ensure_init = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.11.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_v55_perf_main_tt_col3_colonial
		add_stability = -10
		every_subject = {
			limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = 35
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			ordered_owned_location = {
				limit = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
				order_by = population
				max = 3
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col3_independence_fervor_loc_mod
					years = 15
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.11.b
		add_gold = -150
		add_stability = -4
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat value = 0 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col3_colonial_autonomy_act_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = -25
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}
}

# .12 Commonwealth & Trade Reconciliation (triggered by oe_col3_dec_colonial_autonomy_act or 1785+ window)
oe_col3.12 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v122_imperial_federation.dds"
	title = oe_col3.12.t
	desc = oe_col3.12.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev12_seen value = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_col3.12.a
		add_stability = 6
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col3_post_imperial_trade_pact_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = -15
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
